title.heading: Dashboard
title.subheading: Keep an eye on your limits and jump back into streaming in a click.

usage.heading: Usage overview
usage.concurrentHint: Upgrade to run parallel broadcasts or add redundancy destinations.

upload.title: Upload your first video and start your 24/7 setup
upload.description: Your account is empty right now. Add content first, then connect a channel and create your first stream.

connect.title: Connect your first channel
connect.description: Your files are ready. Add a channel next so the service knows where to send your stream.

create.title: Create your first stream
create.description: You already have content and a destination. The next step is to create a stream and launch it.

attention.title: {count} stream needs attention
attention.description: One or more streams need a retry, schedule fix, or manual review. Open streaming to resolve the issue before it affects your channel.

resume.title: Open streams and start your next broadcast
resume.description: Your setup is ready, but nothing is live right now. Open streaming to start a stream, adjust schedules, or review the current lineup.

live.title: {count} stream live right now
live.description: Your channel is on air. Open streaming to stop, adjust, or inspect the live runtime in more detail.

attention.title: Action needed
attention.description: Use the streaming page for retries, schedule fixes, and detailed recovery actions.

warmup.title: Warm up your feed
warmup.description: Go Live a few minutes early to confirm ingest quality before the audience arrives.

rotate.title: Rotate uploads
rotate.description: Archive older assets once a stream ends to reclaim storage for new content.

upgrade.title: Plan the next upgrade
upgrade.description: Hit Compare plans whenever you get close to limits so live events never pause for capacity.

sidebar.title: Plan notes
sidebar.description: Use the plans page only when you need to review limits, compare upgrades, or prepare more capacity for the next event.

errors.title: Some dashboard data is unavailable
errors.quotaDescription: Plan and quota information could not be loaded. Limit indicators may be outdated until the API recovers.
errors.streamsDescription: Streams or assets could not be loaded. Widgets and usage values below may be incomplete.

metadata.title: Dashboard
metadata.description: Monitor usage, manage streams, and keep your channel online.

free.name: Free
free.cta: Upgrade to unlock more storage and longer sessions

fhd_flow.name: FHD Flow
fhd_flow.message: FHD Flow keeps your streams smooth

streamControl.title: Live Stream Controls
streamControl.subtitle: Monitor status and quickly toggle your stream

empty.title: No streams yet
empty.description: Create your first stream to control it directly from the dashboard.

planLimits.title: {plan} plan usage
planLimits.subtitle: Track how close you are to plan limits

upgrade.title: Need more headroom?
upgrade.description: Upgrade to unlock additional storage, longer broadcasts, and more destinations.

cta.title: Need more resources?
